Chemistry 2017-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2017-I.question: Which one of the following is a physical change?
Chemistry 2017-I.explanation: (c)  Physical changes lead to change in the form of a substance, without any change in chemical composition. Coal is composed of carbon, oxygen, and hydrogen. Wood is composed of cellulose, hemicellulose and lignin. Burning of wood, coal and potassium chlorate leads to chemical reaction as their components are chemically active. Platinum being an inert element does not show chemical reaction and show only physical change such as rise in temperature.

Chemistry 2017-I.question: There are two elements-calcium (atomic number 20) and argon (atomic number 18). The mass number of both the elements is 40. They are therefore known as
Chemistry 2017-I.explanation: (c)  Calcium and argon are isobars because they have same atomic mass. Two elements with same neutron number, but different proton number are called isotones. Each of two or more forms of the same element with equal numbers of protons but different numbers of neutrons is called isotope. Isochore is the graphic representation showing lines or surface of constant volume of a physical system.

Chemistry 2017-I.question: 'Plum Pudding Model' for an atom was proposed by
Chemistry 2017-I.explanation: (d)  ‘Plum Pudding Model,’ the scientific model of atom was proposed by J. J. Thomson in which he said that an atom is made up of electrons surrounded by positive charge to balance the negative charges of electrons. Negatively charged electrons are called ‘plums’ surrounded by positively charged particles ‘pudding.’

Chemistry 2017-I.question: What is the number of atoms in 46 g of sodium-23 [N = Avogadro constant)?
Chemistry 2017-I.explanation: (c)  Atomic mass of Sodium = 23 gram = 1 mole of Sodium No. of moles in 46 grams of Sodium = 2; 1 Avogadro’s Number (N) = 1 mole of substance Therefore, 2 moles of Sodium = 2N

Chemistry 2017-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2017-I.question: What is the maximum number of states of matter?
Chemistry 2017-I.explanation: (c)  States of matter can be defined as the forms a substance can occur, and are of five types: solid, liquid, gas, plasma and Bose-Einstein condensates (BEC). Each form differs from the other mainly in structures and densities. Plasma are highly charged particles with high kinetic energy. BEC is a state of matter of a dilute gas of bosons cooled close to absolute zero.

Chemistry 2017-I.question: The molecular mass of sulphuric acid is 98. If 49 g of the acid is dissolved in water to make one litre of solution, what will be the strength of the acid?
Chemistry 2017-I.explanation: (b)  Normality is a way of expressing concentration of a solution and can be calculated by the formula Normality (N) = No. of gram equivalent of solute/volume of solution (in liter) Gram equivalent weight of H2SO4 = Molecular weight/ No. of Hydrogen atom = 98/2 = 49 gm No. of gram equivalent in 49 gm of H2SO4 = 1 So, Normality in 1 liter of solution = 1/1 = 1 N
